result:
I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql` instead of editing `001_init.sql`, because databases that already ran 001 wouldn't pick up an edit. I haven't run it against a database.

The migration does three things:
1. It sets any existing rows with a NULL `status` to `'queued'`. This has to come first, or the NOT NULL step would fail on those rows.
2. It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. It sets the column to NOT NULL.

If you'd rather the schema in `001_init.sql` also say `status text not null default 'queued'`, so fresh setups match, I can change that too.

If any code inserts exports with an explicit `NULL` status, it will now error. I didn't check for that.
